cookieAuth.name: better-auth.session_token
cookieAuth.description: The sign-in session cookie of the web (`__Secure-` prefixed over https). Set by the web’s own sign-in, not by this contract.

bearerAuth.description: The token of `POST /v1/sign-in/token`: a sign-in session. Ended by `POST /v1/sign-out`.

NotSignedIn.description: The request has no valid sign-in session. Contains no user-facing text.

NotFound.description: The workspace or record does not exist or is out of the caller’s reach; the answer is the same for both. Contains no user-facing text.

Forbidden.description: The caller has a place in the workspace, but not the access this route needs. Contains no user-facing text.

HealthResponse.description: Liveness of the API and its dependencies. Contains no error details.

greetingKey.description: i18n message key that the client renders in `locale`.

Locale.description: Catalog locale from packages/i18n: Dutch (nl-NL) or English (en).

path.description: Dot-separated path of the invalid field.

ValidationError.description: The request did not match the contract. Contains no user-facing text.

email.description: The address the account signs in with.

name.description: The person’s own name; null until one is given (TW-11 asks for it).

preferredLocale.description: The language stored on the account; null until one is stored.

bookingEmails.description: Whether the person gets an email when a client books or cancels a class they teach (F050). On for every account until they switch it off. It belongs to the account, so it is the same in every workspace.

canCreateWorkspace.description: Whether the account may set up a workspace: it is on the sign-up allowlist, whether or not it has a workspace already. With no workspace, the first-run screen shows when this is true and the no-access page when it is false. The web and the apps never decide this by rules of their own.

workspaces.description: The workspaces the account has a team role in, by name. Empty when it has none. Workspaces it is only a client of are not listed here, but under `clientWorkspaces`.

clientWorkspaces.description: The workspaces where the account has a joined client relationship, by name; a workspace it is both a team member and a client of is listed here too. Empty when it has none. Until join requests and invitations exist (F029, F032), a client record linked to the account counts as joined. A workspace the account has only asked to join is not listed.

name.description: The name shown in the product.

slug.description: The URL name: `/w/{slug}` on the web.

role.description: What the account is in the workspace; shown as a label, never decided on.

capabilities.description: What the account may do in the workspace, from the permission matrix. The web and the apps show a section or an action only when its capability is listed, never from the role name; the API refuses the rest with `403` anyway.

MeWorkspace.description: A workspace the account has a team role in.

slug.description: The URL name: `/w/{slug}` on the web.

name.description: The name shown in the product.

MeClientWorkspace.description: A workspace the account is a client of: its ID, URL name and name, nothing more. The account’s own client record in it is the only thing that lists it.

name.description: The name shown in the product.

slug.description: The URL name: `/w/{slug}` on the web.

role.description: What the account is on the team; shown as a label, never decided on.

capabilities.description: What the account may do in the workspace, from the permission matrix. The web and the apps show a section or an action only when its capability is listed, never from the role name; the API refuses the rest with `403` anyway.

trainsHere.description: Whether the account trains in the workspace, that is has a trainer profile there (F005): always true for a Trainer, the Owner’s own switch for an Owner.

MyWorkspace.description: A workspace the account is on the team of.

name.description: The person’s own name, as shown in every workspace they are on: trimmed, at least one and at most 120 characters. Empty, blank or longer answers `400` with a field error.

preferredLocale.description: The language to store on the account, for its screens and emails: `nl-NL` or `en`. Any other value, a browser’s `nl-BE` included, is refused with `400`.

bookingEmails.description: Whether to get an email when a client books or cancels a class the person teaches: `true` or `false`, stored on the account and the same in every workspace. Anything that is not a boolean answers `400` with a field error.

surface.description: The app that sends the request: `ios` or `android`. A request with a bearer token that changes `preferredLocale` records the `language_changed` event with this surface; without it nothing is recorded. The web does not send it, and a request without a bearer token ignores it.

UpdateMeRequest.description: What to change on the signed-in account. Fields left out stay as they are.

newEmail.description: The new address, trimmed and stored in lower case. Not an address, or the account’s own current one, answers `400` with a field error on `newEmail`.

RequestEmailChange.description: The address to send the confirmation code to.

InvalidCode.description: The code is wrong, used, replaced, expired or out of attempts, or the address it was sent for has an account by now; nothing says which. Nothing changed. Contains no user-facing text.

code.description: The 6-digit code in the email sent to the new address.

surface.description: The app that sends the request: `ios` or `android`. A request with a bearer token records the `email_changed` event with this surface; without it nothing is recorded. The web does not send it, and a request without a bearer token ignores it.

ConfirmEmailChange.description: The code that confirms the new address.

timeZone.description: The zone of the personal scope: `Europe/Amsterdam`. The day starts and ends on its wall clock.

workspaceCount.description: The workspaces the account trains in and the view spans. The apps show a workspace name on a row only when it is more than one.

items.description: The day’s items in time order, cancelled ones included.

placesAhead.description: *Route vandaag*: the places of the sessions that take place and have not ended, in time order, the same place twice in a row listed once. A session’s place is its location; a class takes place at its workspace’s one location. Only for today (an empty list when nothing is left); left out for any other date. The apps show the route only when it holds 2 or more places.

nextSessionDate.description: The date of the next session that takes place after this day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Only given when the day has no items; left out when there is none.

hasSessions.description: Whether the account is the current trainer of any session at all, past or future. Only computed when the day is empty and no session follows, to tell a new trainer (*Je hebt nog geen sessies*) from one with nothing planned; true otherwise.

MyDay.description: The personal day of a trainer across all their workspaces.

sessionId.description: The session ID. It opens in its own workspace: `GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/sessions/{sessionId}` with the item’s `workspace.id`.

type.description: The kind of session, to be shown in words (*Privé*, *Groep*, *Open Gym*).

status.description: Whether the session still takes place. A cancelled one stays in the list.

timeZone.description: The workspace’s IANA time zone, e.g. `Europe/Amsterdam` (ADR-012).

booked.description: The places taken (not cancelled), for a group class or Open Gym: *{booked}/{capacity} geboekt*. Left out for a private session.

className.description: The class name in the viewer’s language, for a group class: the English name for a viewer whose language is English and a class that has one, else the Dutch name (`pickContentLanguage`). The language is the account’s stored language, else the first supported one of `Accept-Language`, else English (ADR-017). Left out for a private session and Open Gym.

clientName.description: The client’s display name, for a private session; left out for the other kinds. It is the name in the workspace’s client record and holds no contact detail.

PersonalSession.description: A session the signed-in account is the current trainer of, in one of its workspaces. `location` is where a private session takes place and is left out for the other kinds.

slug.description: The URL name: `/w/{slug}` on the web.

name.description: The name shown in the product.

PersonalWorkspace.description: The workspace an item of the personal view is in.

name.description: The name sessions show, up to 120 characters.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the workspace’s default location, the one every new session takes.

Location.description: A place where sessions of the workspace take place.

LocationType.description: The kind of location. Every workspace has one `organization_location` (its own) at go-live; the other kinds exist in the model for later and are not written yet.

postcode.description: A Dutch postcode, stored as `1234 AB`.

houseNumberAddition.description: For example `A` or `2 hoog`; `null` when there is none.

LocationAddress.description: The address, or `null` when the location has none.

count.description: The items of the day, cancelled ones counted.

done.description: How many of the day’s items took place and have ended (`endsAt` at or before now): *2 klaar*. A cancelled item is never done; 0 on a day still to come.

firstStartsAt.description: The start of the first item; left out for an empty day.

lastEndsAt.description: The end of the last item; left out for an empty day.

MyDaySummary.description: *4 sessies · 09:00–19:00*, and how many of them are done.

startsInMinutes.description: Minutes to the start, rounded up; 0 while it runs.

MyDayNext.description: *Straks* / *Nu bezig*: the first item of today that has not ended and is not cancelled. Left out when nothing is left today, and for any day but today.

startsAt.description: The start of the gap, a UTC instant.

endsAt.description: The end of the gap, a UTC instant.

MyDayFreeGap.description: The next free gap of the *Mijn dag* card (*Plannen*): the first stretch of 30 minutes or more without a session that takes place, from now to the end of the day’s last such session. A cancelled session leaves its time free. Only for today; left out when there is none (also after the last session) and for any other date.

name.description: The location’s name.

allOf.description: The location’s address; left out when it has none.

MyDayPlace.description: A place on the route of the day: a location.

count.description: The sessions that day that take place.

firstStartsAt.description: The start of the first one.

MyDayTomorrow.description: The footer *Morgen: 3 sessies, eerste om 07:00*. Cancelled sessions are not counted; left out when the next day has none.

timeZone.description: The zone of the personal scope: `Europe/Amsterdam`. The days follow its wall clock.

workspaceCount.description: The workspaces the account trains in and the view spans.

items.description: The sessions from the start of `from` to the end of `to`, in time order.

MySessions.description: The personal sessions of a trainer across all their workspaces, for a range of days.

email.description: The address the account signs in with.

SignInRequest.description: Asks for the sign-in email. `locale` is the interface language the app resolved; the email follows ADR-019.

token.description: The bearer token: a sign-in session, valid 30 days after its last use and renewed on use. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Unauthorized.description: The request has no valid sign-in session. Contains no user-facing text.

email.description: The address the account signs in with.

DemoRequestRateLimited.description: Too many demo requests from this network, or from everyone, in the last hour.

DemoRequestUnavailable.description: The email could not be sent. Nothing was stored; the visitor may try again later or write to the support address. Contains no user-facing text.

name.description: The visitor’s name: 1 to 100 characters, on one line.

email.description: The address to answer. No email is sent to it by this request.

businessKind.description: The kind of business: a gym with a team, a pilates or yoga studio, or a PT.

trainerCount.description: How many trainers the business has.

message.description: What the visitor would most like to see: up to 2000 characters.

website.description: A honeypot: the form hides this field from people. Leave it empty or out. A request that fills it is dropped without an email, and gets the same answer as any other.

DemoRequest.description: A visitor’s request for a demo. `locale` is the language of the page they used, which the answer follows.

name.description: The name shown in the product.

slug.description: The URL name, made from the name when the workspace is created and never changed by a rename. Lower case letters, digits and hyphens.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone dates and times are shown in, for example `Europe/Amsterdam`.

Workspace.description: A workspace: a gym or an independent trainer’s business.

name.description: The name of the gym or business, as shown in the product.

personName.description: The creator’s own name, stored on the account. Leave it out when the account has one.

CreateWorkspaceRequest.description: Creates a workspace for the caller, who becomes its Owner. Nothing else is asked: the default language, the time zone and the slug are the platform’s defaults.

name.description: The new name, as the product shows it from now on.

UpdateWorkspaceRequest.description: Changes a workspace: its name, its default communication language (the language of emails to people whose own preference is unknown, never what anyone sees on screen, ADR-017), or both. The slug stays, so links keep working. Other fields are ignored.

surface.description: The app that sends the request: `ios` or `android`. A request with a bearer token records the `workspace_switched` event with this surface; without it nothing is recorded. The web does not send it, and a request without a bearer token ignores it.

WorkspaceSwitchedRequest.description: Who sent the report that the person switched workspace.

id.description: The team-member ID: this person’s place on this team.

name.description: The account’s name; empty when the person has not given one.

email.description: The address the account signs in with.

role.description: What the person is on the team.

TeamMember.description: A person on the team of a workspace.

LastOwner.description: The change would leave the workspace without an Owner; nothing changed. Contains no user-facing text.

role.description: The new role: `owner` or `trainer`. There is no `admin` role; it answers 400.

ChangeTeamMemberRole.description: The role a team member gets.

name.description: The name the Owner typed for the person.

email.description: The address the invitation went to, lower case.

emailLocale.description: The language the Owner chose for the email: `nl-NL` or `en`. `null` follows the language of the account with that address, then the workspace’s default.

sentAt.description: When the invitation was last sent: it moves forward when it is sent again.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working: seven days after it was sent. A pending invitation can be past it; the Owner then sends it again.

TrainerInvitation.description: A pending invitation to join the team as a Trainer. The link’s token is only in the email; it is never part of an answer.

invitationId.description: With `invitation_pending`: the ID of the invitation that exists, which the Owner can send again.

TrainerInvitationConflict.description: Nothing was sent. `already_on_team`: an account with the address has a team role in the workspace. `invitation_pending`: the address has a pending invitation. Contains no user-facing text.

TooManyInvitations.description: The workspace made 20 invitations in the last 24 hours; nothing was sent. Contains no user-facing text.

name.description: The person’s name: trimmed, at least one and at most 120 characters. It becomes the account’s name only when the account has none.

email.description: The person’s email address, stored lower case. Invalid answers `400`.

emailLocale.description: The language of the email: `nl-NL` or `en`. Leave it out, or send `null`, to follow the language of the account with that address, then the workspace’s default. Any other value answers `400`.

CreateTrainerInvitationRequest.description: The person to invite to the team as a Trainer.

workspaceName.description: The name of the workspace that invites.

inviterName.description: The name of the Owner who invited, `null` while they have given none. Never their address.

maskedEmail.description: The address the invitation is for, hidden except for its first character and its domain (`l***@example.com`), so a person signed in with another address can see which to use.

InvitationPreview.description: What the link of a valid invitation shows to anyone who holds it, signed in or not.

id.description: The team-member ID: this person’s place on this team.

name.description: The account’s name; empty when the person has not given one.

Trainer.description: A team member who trains in the workspace.

trainsHere.description: The caller trains in the workspace.

TrainerProfile.description: The caller’s own trainer profile: they train in this workspace.

name.description: The new name: trimmed, not blank, at most 120 characters.

UpdateLocationRequest.description: Changes a location: its name, its address (a Dutch one, all or nothing; the postcode is stored as `1234 AB`), or both. `address: null` removes the address; leave `address` out to keep it as it is. The type and which location is the default never change. Other fields are ignored.

postcode.description: A Dutch postcode: four digits, an optional space, two letters. Stored as `1234 AB`.

houseNumberAddition.description: For example `A` or `2 hoog`; optional, at most 10 characters.

LocationAddressInput.description: An address as typed. All or nothing: with any field filled, the postcode, house number, street and city are required.

street.description: The street, as the BAG writes it.

city.description: The city, as the BAG writes it.

AddressLookupResult.description: The street and the city of an address.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this workspace in the last hour. Contains no user-facing text.

Unavailable.description: The address service did not answer in time or answered with an error. Try again later. Contains no user-facing text.

past.description: The session starts before now: it was saved, and no email goes out.

repeatedStart.description: The start happens twice because the clocks went back; the first (summer time) was taken.

confirmationEmail.description: Whether the confirmation (EM-11) goes to the client: it was asked for and the session is not in the past. It is sent after the answer is decided; a failure is reported to error tracking and does not undo the session.

PlannedPrivateSession.description: The private session that was planned, with what the trainer should be told.

type.description: The kind of session. Private sessions are planned here, class dates are a class on a date (`…/group-classes/{classId}/dates`); Open Gym comes later.

status.description: Whether the session still takes place. A session is never deleted.

timeZone.description: The workspace’s IANA time zone, e.g. `Europe/Amsterdam`: the instants are shown in it (ADR-012).

capacity.description: 1 for a private session; the date’s own capacity for a class date.

version.description: Raised by every change; a change says the version it read. Starts at 1.

participants.description: The clients in the session, in the order they were added. One for a private session; none for a class date until bookings exist (M5).

Session.description: A session of the workspace as the team sees it. It holds no email address or other contact detail of a client.

id.description: The trainer’s team-member ID, as in `GET …/trainers`.

name.description: The account’s name; empty when it has none.

SessionTrainer.description: Left out when the session has no trainer (the trainer’s profile ended).

nameEn.description: The class’s English name, `null` without one. Show it to a viewer whose language is English, else the Dutch name (`pickContentLanguage`).

SessionGroupClass.description: The class of a class date (F021); left out for the other kinds.

name.description: The client’s name.

attendanceStatus.description: What became of the client’s place: `booked` from the start; attendance and cancellations change it in later features.

SessionParticipant.description: A client’s place in a session.

clientId.description: The client of the workspace the session is for.

trainerId.description: The trainer’s team-member ID, from `GET …/trainers`. Leave it out to plan for yourself (the caller must train in the workspace). An Owner may plan for any trainer of the workspace, a Trainer only for themself (`403` otherwise).

localDate.description: The date in the workspace’s time zone: `YYYY-MM-DD`. A date that is none (30 February) answers `400` on `localDate`.

localStart.description: The start in the workspace’s time zone: `HH:mm`, 24 hours. A time the clocks skip (02:30 on 28 March 2027) answers `400` on `localStart` with the code `time_does_not_exist`; a time they repeat (02:30 on 25 October 2026) takes the first.

durationMinutes.description: The length in minutes: 15 to 240 in steps of 5. Any other value answers `400` on `durationMinutes`.

notify.description: Whether to email the client the confirmation (EM-11). Not sent for a session that starts in the past, whatever this says.

surface.description: The app that sends the request: `ios` or `android`. A request with a bearer token records the `private_session_created` event with this surface; without it nothing is recorded. The web does not send it, and a request without a bearer token ignores it.

PlanPrivateSessionRequest.description: A private session to plan: one client, one trainer, a local date, start and length.

past.description: The new time is before now: it was saved, and no email goes out.

repeatedStart.description: The new start happens twice because the clocks went back; the first (summer time) was taken.

changeEmail.description: Whether the change (EM-04) goes to the client: it was asked for and the new time is not in the past. It is sent after the answer is decided; a failure is reported to error tracking and does not undo the change.

ReschedulePrivateSessionResult.description: The private session after it moved, with what the trainer should be told.

code.description: `session_changed`: someone changed the session after the `version` sent (AC8); `session_cancelled`: the session was cancelled and stays as it is.

name.description: The account’s name.

changedBy.description: Who changed the session last, for `session_changed`; left out when that person has been removed or their account has no name.

SessionConflict.description: The change was refused because of the session’s state; nothing was stored. Holds the session as it is now, so the form can show its values.

localDate.description: The date in the workspace’s time zone: `YYYY-MM-DD`. A date that is none (30 February) answers `400` on `localDate`.

localStart.description: The start in the workspace’s time zone: `HH:mm`, 24 hours. A time the clocks skip (02:30 on 28 March 2027) answers `400` on `localStart` with the code `time_does_not_exist`; a time they repeat (02:30 on 25 October 2026) takes the first.

durationMinutes.description: The length in minutes: 15 to 240 in steps of 5. Any other value answers `400` on `durationMinutes`.

notify.description: Whether to email the client the change (EM-04). Not sent when the new time is in the past, whatever this says.

version.description: The `version` of the session the person saw. If the session has been changed since, nothing is stored and the answer is `409` with the session as it is now.

surface.description: The app that sends the request: `ios` or `android`. A request with a bearer token records the `private_session_rescheduled` event with this surface; without it nothing is recorded. The web does not send it, and a request without a bearer token ignores it.

ReschedulePrivateSessionRequest.description: A new local date, start and length for a private session, and the version the person saw.

clientId.description: The client ID the sessions are of.

timeZone.description: The workspace’s IANA time zone, e.g. `Europe/Amsterdam` (ADR-012).

sessions.description: The next sessions, soonest first: at most 5. Empty for a client without any.

UpcomingSessions.description: A client’s upcoming private sessions, for their profile (TW-02, TM-03).

nameEn.description: The English name, `null` without one. Show it to a viewer whose language is English, else the Dutch name (`pickContentLanguage` of @fivvi/i18n).

descriptionEn.description: The English description, or `null`: shown only to English viewers.

durationMinutes.description: How long a date of the class lasts: 15 to 240 minutes in steps of 5.

allOf.description: The usual trainer. Left out for *Trainer nodig* (none).

GroupClass.description: A class of the workspace: what it is called, who usually teaches it, how many people fit and how long it lasts. It is not a point in time; a class on a date is a `group` session.

allOf.description: The first date, when the request had a `firstDate`.

CreatedGroupClass.description: The class that was created, with its first date when the request had one.

nameNl.description: The Dutch name: trimmed, 1 to 80 characters.

nameEn.description: The English name: trimmed, at most 80 characters. A blank text means none (and, in a change, clears it).

descriptionNl.description: The Dutch description: trimmed, at most 500 characters. A blank text means none (and, in a change, clears it).

descriptionEn.description: The English description: trimmed, at most 500 characters. A blank text means none (and, in a change, clears it).

trainerId.description: The usual trainer’s team-member ID, from `GET …/trainers`. Leave it out, or send `null`, for *Trainer nodig*. A team member who does not train in the workspace answers `404`.

durationMinutes.description: 15 to 240 minutes in steps of 5; any other value answers `400` on `durationMinutes`.

surface.description: The app that sends the request: `ios` or `android`. A request with a bearer token records the `class_created` event (and `class_scheduled` with a first date) with this surface; without it nothing is recorded. The web does not send it, and a request without a bearer token ignores it.

CreateGroupClassRequest.description: A class to create: the Dutch name, optionally an English one, descriptions, the usual trainer, capacity and duration, and optionally its first date.

localDate.description: The date in the workspace’s time zone: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

localStart.description: The start in the workspace’s time zone: `HH:mm`, 24 hours.

FirstGroupClassDate.description: Puts the new class on one date in the same request (the apps’ quick create, TD-05): class and date are stored together or not at all. A refused date (`400` on `firstDate.localDate` or `firstDate.localStart`) leaves no class behind.

nameNl.description: The new Dutch name: trimmed, 1 to 80 characters.

nameEn.description: The new English name: trimmed, at most 80 characters. A blank text means none (and, in a change, clears it).

descriptionNl.description: The new Dutch description: trimmed, at most 500 characters. A blank text means none (and, in a change, clears it).

descriptionEn.description: The new English description: trimmed, at most 500 characters. A blank text means none (and, in a change, clears it).

trainerId.description: The new usual trainer’s team-member ID; `null` makes the class *Trainer nodig*; left out keeps it.

durationMinutes.description: The new duration, 15 to 240 minutes in steps of 5.

UpdateGroupClassRequest.description: Changes a class: every field left out stays as it is. Dates already planned keep their own trainer, capacity and times (they were copied when they were planned). Other fields are ignored.

localDate.description: The date in the workspace’s time zone: `YYYY-MM-DD`. A date that is none (30 February) answers `400` on `localDate`.

localStart.description: The start in the workspace’s time zone: `HH:mm`, 24 hours. A time the clocks skip (02:30 on 28 March 2027) answers `400` on `localStart` with the code `time_does_not_exist`; a time they repeat (02:30 on 25 October 2026) takes the first.

trainerId.description: The trainer of this date, a team-member ID from `GET …/trainers`. Leave it out for the class’s usual trainer; `null` plans the date as *Trainer nodig*.

capacity.description: The capacity of this date, 1 to 100. Leave it out for the class’s.

surface.description: The app that sends the request: `ios` or `android`. A request with a bearer token records the `class_scheduled` event with this surface; without it nothing is recorded. The web does not send it, and a request without a bearer token ignores it.

ScheduleGroupClassDateRequest.description: A class on a date: a local date and start; the end follows from the class’s duration.

ClassDateChanged.description: The date was changed since the version in the request; nothing was written. `session` is the date as it is now, to show the reloaded values. Contains no user-facing text.

version.description: The version of the date the change was made from (`Session.version`). If the date changed since, the answer is `409` and nothing is written.

localStart.description: The new start, `HH:mm` in the workspace’s time zone. Leave it out to keep it.

localEnd.description: The new end, `HH:mm` on the same day as the start. Leave it out to keep its time of day: a start moved alone does not move the end with it, and one moved to or past the unchanged end is refused like any end. An end that is not after the start answers `400` on `localEnd` with the code `end_before_start`.

capacity.description: The new capacity of this date, 1 to 100. Leave it out to keep it.

UpdateGroupClassDateRequest.description: Changes one date of a class (CO-04): the start, the end and the capacity, each only when given. The date stays on its day. The class itself never changes.

url.description: The join link in full, `https://…/j/{code}`: the one link of the workspace. The QR code and the poster show this same link.

renewedAt.description: When the Owner last renewed the link, a UTC instant; `null` while it is the link the workspace started with.

JoinLink.description: The join link (*aanmeldlink*) of a workspace: where a new client asks to become a client.

surface.description: The app that sends the request: `ios` or `android`. A request with a bearer token records the `join_link_renewed` event with this surface; without it nothing is recorded. The web does not send it, and a request without a bearer token ignores it.

RenewJoinLinkRequest.description: Who sends the renewal. The body is optional; the web sends none.

items.description: This page of clients, sorted by name.

total.description: How many clients match, over all pages.

ClientList.description: One page of the clients of a workspace.

id.description: The client ID: this person’s record in this workspace.

name.description: The name as the team wrote it.

email.description: The email address, lower case. Every client has one.

emailLocale.description: The language for the client’s emails the team set: `nl-NL` or `en`. `null` follows the workspace’s default language.
